Use when performing joint NeRF-and-detection tasks where multi-view consistency is critical for accurate 3D bounding box regression and free-space suppression [S1, S2].

The claim states that the method is used for joint NeRF-and-detection tasks where multi-view consistency is critical for 3D bounding box regression and free-space suppression. Source [S1] confirms that NeRF-Det is a joint NeRF-and-Detection method that uses a shared geometry-based MLP to mask out free space and reduce ambiguity. Source [S2] explicitly states that the shared G-MLP enables the constraint of multi-view consistency to be propagated from the NeRF branch to the detection branch, and that without it, performance drops significantly, indicating its critical nature. Both aspects of the claim (free-space suppression and multi-view consistency importance) are directly supported by the provided evidence.
